faq.q: What's new in Clash of Clans Town Hall 19?
faq.a: The latest update adds Town Hall 19, where you choose how it looks and which troops defend it, and Squads: deployable troop hordes unlocked at Town Hall 8 and upgraded with unique abilities at Town Hall 19.

faq.q: Is Clash of Clans appropriate for a 10-year-old?
faq.a: Google Play rates it Everyone 10+ for fantasy violence. It has clan chat with strangers, so younger players should join a friends-only clan and use Supercell ID parental settings and purchase authentication.

faq.q: Why is Clash of Clans so easy now?
faq.a: Recent updates have shortened many upgrade times and costs and added features like Squads, so progress feels faster than in early versions. Higher Town Hall levels still take time.

faq.q: How do I save my Clash of Clans village?
faq.a: Connect to Supercell ID in settings. Your village is then linked to your email and can be loaded on any phone.
